units.zh: 寧宗沖聖嗣孝皇帝，諱懿璘質班，明宗第二子也。
units.en: Emperor Ningzong Chong Sheng Si Xiao, taboo name Yilianzhen Shiraban, was Mingzong's second son.
units.literal: Emperor Ningzong Chong Sheng Si Xiao, taboo name Yilianzhen Shiraban, was Mingzong's second son.

units.zh: 母曰八不沙皇后，乃蠻真氏。
units.en: His mother was Empress Babusha of the Naiman Zhen clan.
units.literal: His mother was Empress Babusha of the Naiman Zhen clan.

units.zh: 初，武宗有子二人，長明宗，次文宗。
units.en: Earlier, Wuzong had two sons — the elder Mingzong, the younger Wenzong.
units.literal: Earlier, Wuzong had two sons — the elder Mingzong, the younger Wenzong.

units.zh: 延祐中，明宗封周王，出居朔漠。
units.en: During Yanyou, Mingzong was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and went out to dwell in the northern desert.
units.literal: During Yanyou, Mingzong was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and went out to dwell in the northern desert.

units.zh: 泰定之際，正統遂偏。
units.en: At the time of Taiding, orthodox succession was thereby skewed.
units.literal: At the time of Taiding, orthodox succession was thereby skewed.

units.zh: 天歷元年，文宗入紹大統，內難既平，即遣使奉皇帝璽綬，北迎明宗。
units.en: First year of Tianli, Wenzong entered to continue the Great Foundation; once the inner turmoil was pacified, he immediately dispatched envoys bearing the imperial seal and cord to welcome Mingzong from the north.
units.literal: First year of Tianli, Wenzong entered to continue the Great Foundation; once the inner turmoil was pacified, he immediately dispatched envoys bearing the imperial seal and cord to welcome Mingzong from the north.

units.zh: 明宗崩，文宗復即皇帝位。
units.en: Mingzong died; Wenzong again ascended the imperial throne.
units.literal: Mingzong died; Wenzong again ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 明宗有子二人，長妥歡帖木耳，次即帝也。
units.en: Mingzong had two sons — the elder Toghan Temür, the younger being the Emperor.
units.literal: Mingzong had two sons — the elder Toghan Temür, the younger being the Emperor.

units.zh: 天歷三年二月乙巳，封帝為鄜王。
units.en: Third year of Tianli, second month, on yisi day, the Emperor was enfeoffed Prince of Fu.
units.literal: Third year of Tianli, second month, on yisi day, the Emperor was enfeoffed Prince of Fu.

units.zh: 至順三年八月己酉，文宗崩於上都，皇后導揚末命，申固讓初誌，傳位於明宗之子。
units.en: Third year of Zhishun, eighth month, on jiyou day, Wenzong died at Shangdu; the empress guided and proclaimed his final command, reiterated the original intent of firm yielding, and transmitted the throne to Mingzong's sons.
units.literal: Third year of Zhishun, eighth month, on jiyou day, Wenzong died at Shangdu; the empress guided and proclaimed his final command, reiterated the original intent of firm yielding, and transmitted the throne to Mingzong's sons.

units.zh: 時妥歡帖木耳出居靜江，帝以文宗眷愛之篤，留京師。
units.en: At that time Toghan Temür was residing at Jingjiang; because of Wenzong's deep affection for the Emperor, he remained at the capital.
units.literal: At that time Toghan Temür was residing at Jingjiang; because of Wenzong's deep affection for the Emperor, he remained at the capital.

units.zh: 太師、太平王、右丞相燕鐵木兒，請立帝以繼大統。
units.en: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, and right chancellor Yan Temür requested that the Emperor be installed to continue the Great Foundation.
units.literal: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, and right chancellor Yan Temür requested that the Emperor be installed to continue the Great Foundation.

units.zh: 於是遣使征諸王會京師，中書百司政務，咸啟中宮取進止。
units.en: Thereupon envoys were dispatched to summon the princes to assemble at the capital; the hundred offices of the central secretariat in all governmental affairs reported to the inner palace for approval.
units.literal: Thereupon envoys were dispatched to summon the princes to assemble at the capital; the hundred offices of the central secretariat in all governmental affairs reported to the inner palace for approval.

units.zh: 甲寅，中書省臣奉中宮旨，預備大朝會賞賜金銀幣帛等物。
units.en: On jiayin day, central secretariat officials received the inner palace's command to prepare gold, silver, silks, and brocades and other goods for the great court assembly rewards.
units.literal: On jiayin day, central secretariat officials received the inner palace's command to prepare gold, silver, silks, and brocades and other goods for the great court assembly rewards.

units.zh: 乙卯，燕鐵木兒奉中宮旨，賜駙馬也不幹子歡忒哈赤、太尉孛蘭奚、句容郡王答鄰答裏、僉事小薛、呵麻剌臺之子禿帖木兒、公主本答裏、諸王醜漢妃公主臺忽都魯、諸王卯澤妃公主完者臺及公主本答裏、徹裏帖木兒等金、銀、幣、鈔有差。
units.en: On yimao day, Yan Temür, following the inner palace's command, granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks, and notes to imperial son-in-law Yebuqan's son Huantekha, Grand Master of War Bolanxi, Prince of Jurong Commandery Dalindari, commissioner Xiaoxue, Hamalatai's son Tutemür, Princess Bendali, Princess Taihuduru consort of Prince Chouhan, Princess Wanzhetai consort of Prince Maoza, and again Princess Bendali, Cheritemür, and others.
units.literal: On yimao day, Yan Temür, following the inner palace's command, granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks, and notes to imperial son-in-law Yebuqan's son Huantekha, Grand Master of War Bolanxi, Prince of Jurong Commandery Dalindari, commissioner Xiaoxue, Hamalatai's son Tutemür, Princess Bendali, Princess Taihuduru consort of Prince Chouhan, Princess Wanzhetai consort of Prince Maoza, and again Princess Bendali, Cheritemür, and others.

units.zh: 是月，渾源、雲內二州隕霜殺禾，冀寧路之陽曲、河曲二縣及荊門州皆旱，江水又溢，高郵府之寶應、興化二縣，德安府之雲夢、應城二縣大雨，水。
units.en: That month, in Hunyuan and Yunnei the 2 prefectures frost killed the grain; in Jining Route's Yangqu and Hequ the 2 counties and Jingmen Prefecture all suffered drought; the Yangzi again overflowed; in Gaoyou Prefecture's Baoying and Xinghua the 2 counties and Dean Prefecture's Yunmeng and Yingcheng the 2 counties there was great rain and flooding.
units.literal: That month, in Hunyuan and Yunnei the two prefectures frost killed the grain; in Jining Route's Yangqu and Hequ the two counties and Jingmen Prefecture all suffered drought; the Yangzi again overflowed; in Gaoyou Prefecture's Baoying and Xinghua the two counties and Dean Prefecture's Yunmeng and Yingcheng the two counties there was great rain and flooding.

units.zh: 九月丁丑，填星犯太微垣左執法。
units.en: Ninth month, on dingchou day, Saturn invaded the Left Enforcement star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
units.literal: Ninth month, on dingchou day, Saturn invaded the Left Enforcement star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 辛巳，修皇太后儀仗。
units.en: On xinsi day, the empress dowager's ceremonial regalia was repaired.
units.literal: On xinsi day, the empress dowager's ceremonial regalia was repaired.

units.zh: 是夜，地震有聲來自北。
units.en: That night, an earthquake sounded from the north.
units.literal: That night, an earthquake sounded from the north.

units.zh: 是月，益都路之莒、沂二州，泰安州之奉符縣，濟寧路之魚臺、豐縣，曹州之楚丘縣，平江、常州、鎮江三路，松江府、江陰州，中興路之江陵縣，皆大水。
units.en: That month, in Yidu Route's Ju and Yi the 2 prefectures, Taian Prefecture's Fengfu County, Jining Route's Yutai and Feng Counties, Caozhou's Qiuchu County, Pingjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang the 3 routes, Songjiang Prefecture, Jiangyin Prefecture, and Zhongxing Route's Jiangling County — all suffered great flooding.
units.literal: That month, in Yidu Route's Ju and Yi the two prefectures, Taian Prefecture's Fengfu County, Jining Route's Yutai and Feng Counties, Caozhou's Qiuchu County, Pingjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang the three routes, Songjiang Prefecture, Jiangyin Prefecture, and Zhongxing Route's Jiangling County — all suffered great flooding.

units.zh: 河南府之洛陽縣旱。
units.en: Luoyang County of Henan Prefecture suffered drought.
units.literal: Luoyang County of Henan Prefecture suffered drought.

units.zh: 十月庚子，帝即位於大明殿，大赦天下，詔曰：
units.en: Tenth month, on gengzi day, the Emperor ascended the throne in Daming Hall, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and the edict said:
units.literal: Tenth month, on gengzi day, the Emperor ascended the throne in Daming Hall, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and the edict said:

units.zh: 洪惟太祖皇帝，啟辟疆宇；
units.en: Grandly considering the Taizu Emperor, who opened and extended the realm;
units.literal: Grandly considering the Taizu Emperor, who opened and extended the realm;

units.zh: 世祖皇帝，統一萬方；
units.en: the Shizu Emperor, who unified the myriad regions;
units.literal: the Shizu Emperor, who unified the myriad regions;

units.zh: 列聖相承，法度明著。
units.en: the successive sagely emperors who inherited one another, with laws and standards clearly established.
units.literal: the successive sagely emperors who inherited one another, with laws and standards clearly established.

units.zh: 我曲律皇帝入纂大統，修舉庶政，動合成法，授大寶位於普顏篤皇帝以及格堅皇帝。
units.en: Our Emperor Qutuqtu entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, repaired and raised all government affairs, and in action conformed to law; he bestowed the Great Treasure upon Emperors Buyan Toq and Gegegen.
units.literal: Our Emperor Qutuqtu entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, repaired and raised all government affairs, and in action conformed to law; he bestowed the Great Treasure upon Emperors Buyan Toq and Gegegen.

units.zh: 歷數之歸，實當在我忽都篤皇帝、紥牙篤皇帝，而各播越遼遠。
units.en: The mandate of Heaven's return truly rested with Us upon Emperors Qoshila and Jaya'adu, yet each was cast far and wandered in distant lands.
units.literal: The mandate of Heaven's return truly rested with Us upon Emperors Qoshila and Jaya'adu, yet each was cast far and wandered in distant lands.

units.zh: 時則有若燕鐵木兒，建義效忠，戢平內難，以定邦國，協恭推戴紥牙篤皇帝。
units.en: At that time there was one such as Yan Temür, who raised righteous loyalty and served with devotion, quelled and pacified inner turmoil, settled the state, and with united reverence supported and installed Emperor Jaya'adu.
units.literal: At that time there was one such as Yan Temür, who raised righteous loyalty and served with devotion, quelled and pacified inner turmoil, settled the state, and with united reverence supported and installed Emperor Jaya'adu.

units.zh: 登極之始，即以讓兄之詔明告天下。
units.en: At the beginning of his accession he forthwith made clear to all under Heaven the edict yielding to his elder brother.
units.literal: At the beginning of his accession he forthwith made clear to all under Heaven the edict yielding to his elder brother.

units.zh: 隨奉璽紱，遠迓忽都篤皇帝，朔方言還，奄棄臣庶。
units.en: Then bearing the seal and cord he went far to welcome Emperor Qoshila; when word came from the northern frontier that he was returning, he suddenly abandoned his subjects.
units.literal: Then bearing the seal and cord he went far to welcome Emperor Qoshila; when word came from the northern frontier that he was returning, he suddenly abandoned his subjects.

units.zh: 紥牙篤皇帝，薦正宸極，仁義之至，視民如傷，恩澤旁被，無間遠邇。
units.en: Emperor Jaya'adu ascended and rectified the imperial throne; his benevolence and righteousness reached the utmost — viewing the people as wounded, his grace spread on every side, without distinction between far and near.
units.literal: Emperor Jaya'adu ascended and rectified the imperial throne; his benevolence and righteousness reached the utmost — viewing the people as wounded, his grace spread on every side, without distinction between far and near.

units.zh: 顧育眇躬，尤篤慈愛。
units.en: In nurturing Our young person he was especially deep in compassionate love.
units.literal: In nurturing Our young person he was especially deep in compassionate love.

units.zh: 賓天之日，皇后傳顧命於太師、太平王、右丞相、答剌罕燕帖木兒，太保、浚寧王、知樞密院事伯顏等，謂聖體彌留，益推固讓之初誌，以宗社之重，屬諸大兄忽都篤皇帝之世嫡。
units.en: On the day he ascended to Heaven, the empress transmitted the final command to Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, right chancellor, and dalaqan Yan Temür, Grand Guardian, Prince of Jünning, and privy council administrator Bayan, and others, saying the sacred person was critically lingering and should further advance the original intent of firm yielding; for the weight of altars and state, the charge was placed upon the legitimate heir in the line of the Great Elder Brother Emperor Qoshila.
units.literal: On the day he ascended to Heaven, the empress transmitted the final command to Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, right chancellor, and dalaqan Yan Temür, Grand Guardian, Prince of Jünning, and privy council administrator Bayan, and others, saying the sacred person was critically lingering and should further advance the original intent of firm yielding; for the weight of altars and state, the charge was placed upon the legitimate heir in the line of the Great Elder Brother Emperor Qoshila.

units.zh: 乃遣使召諸王宗親，以十月一日來會於大都，與宗王、大臣同奉遺詔。
units.en: Envoys were then dispatched to summon the princes and imperial kin to assemble at Dadu on the 1st day of the 10th month, jointly to follow the testamentary edict together with the princes and great ministers.
units.literal: Envoys were then dispatched to summon the princes and imperial kin to assemble at Dadu on the first day of the tenth month, jointly to follow the testamentary edict together with the princes and great ministers.

units.zh: 揆諸成憲，宜禦神器，以至順三年十月初四日，即皇帝位於大明殿，可大赦天下。
units.en: Measured against the established statutes, he ought to undertake the sacred regalia; on the 4th day of the 10th month of the third year of Zhishun, he ascended the imperial throne in Daming Hall — a general amnesty throughout the realm may be proclaimed.
units.literal: Measured against the established statutes, he ought to undertake the sacred regalia; on the fourth day of the tenth month of the third year of Zhishun, he ascended the imperial throne in Daming Hall — a general amnesty throughout the realm may be proclaimed.

units.zh: 自至順三年十月初四日昧爽以前，除謀反大逆、謀殺祖父母父母、妻妾殺夫、奴婢殺主、謀故殺人、但犯強盜、印造偽鈔、蠱毒魘魅犯上者不赦外，其餘一切罪犯，咸赦除之。
units.en: From before dawn on the 4th day of the 10th month of the third year of Zhishun, except for plotting rebellion or great treason, plotting to kill grandparents or parents, wives or concubines killing husbands, slaves or bondmaids killing masters, plotting deliberate murder, those who committed robbery, forging false notes, or sorcery and malign enchantment offending superiors — all not pardoned — all other crimes whatsoever are pardoned and remitted.
units.literal: From before dawn on the fourth day of the tenth month of the third year of Zhishun, except for plotting rebellion or great treason, plotting to kill grandparents or parents, wives or concubines killing husbands, slaves or bondmaids killing masters, plotting deliberate murder, those who committed robbery, forging false notes, or sorcery and malign enchantment offending superiors — all not pardoned — all other crimes whatsoever are pardoned and remitted.

units.zh: 大都、上都、興和三路，差稅免三年。
units.en: In Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe the 3 routes, corvée tax is remitted for 3 years.
units.literal: In Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe the three routes, corvée tax is remitted for three years.

units.zh: 腹裏差發並其餘諸郡不納差發去處，稅糧十分為率，免二分。
units.en: Within the metropolitan region, corvée levies and all other commanderies that do not submit corvée levies — grain tax at the rate of 10 parts, 2 parts remitted.
units.literal: Within the metropolitan region, corvée levies and all other commanderies that do not submit corvée levies — grain tax at the rate of ten parts, two parts remitted.

units.zh: 江淮以南，夏稅亦免二分。
units.en: South of the Yangzi and Huai, summer tax also has 2 parts remitted.
units.literal: South of the Yangzi and Huai, summer tax also has two parts remitted.

units.zh: 土木工役，除倉庫必合修理外，毋復創造，以紓民力。
units.en: Civil engineering labor — except warehouses that must be repaired, no further new construction, to ease the people's strength.
units.literal: Civil engineering labor — except warehouses that must be repaired, no further new construction, to ease the people's strength.

units.zh: 民間在前應有逋欠差稅課程，盡行蠲免。
units.en: Among the people, all past overdue corvée taxes and levies are entirely remitted.
units.literal: Among the people, all past overdue corvée taxes and levies are entirely remitted.

units.zh: 監察御史、肅政廉訪司官並內外三品以上正官，歲舉才堪守令者一人，申達省部，先行錄用。
units.en: Surveillance censors, integrity and investigation officials, and regular officials of the 3rd rank and above within and without — each year recommend 1 person fit to serve as prefect or magistrate, report upward to the provincial departments, and employ first on record.
units.literal: Surveillance censors, integrity and investigation officials, and regular officials of the third rank and above within and without — each year recommend one person fit to serve as prefect or magistrate, report upward to the provincial departments, and employ first on record.

units.zh: 如果稱職，舉官優加旌擢。
units.en: If they prove competent in office, the recommending official is specially rewarded and promoted.
units.literal: If they prove competent in office, the recommending official is specially rewarded and promoted.

units.zh: 一任之內，或犯贓私者，量其輕重黜罰。
units.en: Within 1 term of office, if they commit corruption for private gain, according to the severity they are dismissed and punished.
units.literal: Within one term of office, if they commit corruption for private gain, according to the severity they are dismissed and punished.

units.zh: 其不該原免重囚，淹禁三年以上、疑不能決者，申達省部，詳讞釋放。
units.en: Those serious criminals who ought not be pardoned, detained 3 years or more with doubts preventing decision — report upward to the provincial departments for detailed review and release.
units.literal: Those serious criminals who ought not be pardoned, detained three years or more with doubts preventing decision — report upward to the provincial departments for detailed review and release.

units.zh: 學校農桑、孝義貞節、科舉取士、國學貢試，並依舊制。
units.en: Schools and agriculture, filial conduct and chaste integrity, examination recruitment of scholars, and National University tribute examinations — all follow the old statutes.
units.literal: Schools and agriculture, filial conduct and chaste integrity, examination recruitment of scholars, and National University tribute examinations — all follow the old statutes.

units.zh: 廣海、雲南梗化之民，詔書到日，限六十日內出官，與免本罪，許以自新。
units.en: Among the recalcitrant peoples of Guanghai and Yunnan, from the day the edict arrives they are limited to 60 days to surrender to officials; their original crimes are remitted and self-renewal is permitted.
units.literal: Among the recalcitrant peoples of Guanghai and Yunnan, from the day the edict arrives they are limited to sixty days to surrender to officials; their original crimes are remitted and self-renewal is permitted.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 肆予沖人，托於天下臣民之上，任大守重，若涉淵冰。
units.en: Now I, a young person, am set upon all under Heaven's subjects; the charge is great and the guardianship heavy — like treading upon deep ice.
units.literal: Now I, a young person, am set upon all under Heaven's subjects; the charge is great and the guardianship heavy — like treading upon deep ice.

units.zh: 尚賴宗王大臣、百司庶府，交修乃職，思盡厥忠。
units.en: I still rely upon the imperial princes, great ministers, and the hundred offices and many agencies jointly to repair their duties and think to exhaust their loyalty.
units.literal: I still rely upon the imperial princes, great ministers, and the hundred offices and many agencies jointly to repair their duties and think to exhaust their loyalty.

units.zh: 嘉與億兆之民，共保承平之治。
units.en: May We together with the hundred millions of the people jointly preserve the governance of enduring peace.
units.literal: May We together with the hundred millions of the people jointly preserve the governance of enduring peace.

units.zh: 咨爾多方，體予至意！
units.en: I announce to you of the many regions — embody My utmost intent!
units.literal: I announce to you of the many regions — embody My utmost intent!

units.zh: 故茲詔示，想知悉。
units.en: Therefore this edict is proclaimed — let it be known.
units.literal: Therefore this edict is proclaimed — let it be known.

units.zh: 辛丑，以知樞密院事撒敦為御史大夫，中書右丞撒迪為中書平章政事，宣政使闊裏吉思為中書左丞，中書平章政事禿兒哈鐵木兒知樞密院事。
units.en: On xinchou day, privy council administrator Sadun was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Sadi was made central secretariat associate grand councillor; Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner Korqos was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat associate grand councillor Toghto Temür was made privy council administrator.
units.literal: On xinchou day, privy council administrator Sadun was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Sadi was made central secretariat associate grand councillor; Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner Korqos was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat associate grand councillor Toghto Temür was made privy council administrator.

units.zh: 乙巳，造皇太后玉冊、玉寶。
units.en: On yisi day, the empress dowager's jade book and jade seal were made.
units.literal: On yisi day, the empress dowager's jade book and jade seal were made.

units.zh: 丁未，皇太后命作兩宮幄殿、車乘、供帳。
units.en: On dingwei day, the empress dowager ordered the making of canopy halls, carriages, and furnishings for the 2 palaces.
units.literal: On dingwei day, the empress dowager ordered the making of canopy halls, carriages, and furnishings for the two palaces.

units.zh: 戊申，賞賚諸王金、幣，其數如文宗即位之制。
units.en: On wushen day, the princes were rewarded with gold and silks in amounts according to the precedent of Wenzong's accession.
units.literal: On wushen day, the princes were rewarded with gold and silks in amounts according to the precedent of Wenzong's accession.

units.zh: 立徽政、中政二院。
units.en: The Huizheng and Central Domestic Affairs Courts were established.
units.literal: The Huizheng and Central Domestic Affairs Courts were established.

units.zh: 己酉，太白犯斗宿。
units.en: On jiyou day, Venus invaded the Dipper constellation.
units.literal: On jiyou day, Venus invaded the Dipper constellation.

units.zh: 敕：「諸王、駙馬、勛舊大臣及中書省、樞密院、御史臺秩正二品，百司庶府秩至一品者，闕門之內，得施繩床以坐，餘皆禁之。」
units.en: An edict: "Within the palace gates, princes, imperial sons-in-law, meritorious elder ministers, and those of the central secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate at the regular 2nd rank, and the hundred offices and many agencies at the 1st rank, may use corded couches to sit; all others are forbidden."
units.literal: An edict: "Within the palace gates, princes, imperial sons-in-law, meritorious elder ministers, and those of the central secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate at the regular second rank, and the hundred offices and many agencies at the first rank, may use corded couches to sit; all others are forbidden."

units.zh: 庚戌，修郊祀法服。
units.en: On gengxu day, suburban sacrifice ritual garments were repaired.
units.literal: On gengxu day, suburban sacrifice ritual garments were repaired.

units.zh: 以宦者鐵古思、哈裏兀答兒、黑狗者、闊闊出並為中政院使。
units.en: The eunuchs Tiegu Si, Hari'udar, Heigouzhe, and Kuokuochu were all made commissioners of the Central Domestic Affairs Court.
units.literal: The eunuchs Tiegu Si, Hari'udar, Heigouzhe, and Kuokuochu were all made commissioners of the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

units.zh: 辛亥，以江浙歲比不登，其海運糧不及數，俟來歲補運。
units.en: On xinhai day, because Jiang-Zhe had several years of poor harvests in succession and sea-transport grain did not reach the quota, it was ordered to be supplemented in the coming year.
units.literal: On xinhai day, because Jiang-Zhe had several years of poor harvests in succession and sea-transport grain did not reach the quota, it was ordered to be supplemented in the coming year.

units.zh: 壬子，定婦人犯私鹽罪，著為令。
units.en: On renzi day, the crime of women violating private salt regulations was fixed as statute.
units.literal: On renzi day, the crime of women violating private salt regulations was fixed as statute.

units.zh: 甲寅，諸王不賽因遣使貢塔裏牙八十八斤、佩刀八十，賜鈔三千三百錠。
units.en: On jiayin day, Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting 88 jin of rhinoceros horn and 80 girdle knives; 3,300 ingots of notes were granted.
units.literal: On jiayin day, Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting eighty-eight jin of rhinoceros horn and eighty girdle knives; three thousand three hundred ingots of notes were granted.

units.zh: 乙卯，以即位告祭南郊。
units.en: On yimao day, the accession was announced with sacrifice at the southern suburb.
units.literal: On yimao day, the accession was announced with sacrifice at the southern suburb.

units.zh: 丙辰，給宿衛士、蒙古、漢軍三萬人禦寒衣。
units.en: On bingchen day, winter clothing was issued to 30,000 palace guardsmen, Mongol troops, and Han troops.
units.literal: On bingchen day, winter clothing was issued to thirty thousand palace guardsmen, Mongol troops, and Han troops.

units.zh: 命江浙行省範銅造和寧宣聖廟祭器，凡百三十有五事。
units.en: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast bronze ritual vessels for the Heaning Sagely King Temple — 135 items in all.
units.literal: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast bronze ritual vessels for the Heaning Sagely King Temple — one hundred thirty-five items in all.

units.zh: 己未，告祭太廟。
units.en: On jiwei day, sacrifice was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On jiwei day, sacrifice was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 庚申，告祭社稷。
units.en: On gengshen day, sacrifice was announced at the Altar of Soil and Grain.
units.literal: On gengshen day, sacrifice was announced at the Altar of Soil and Grain.

units.zh: 以伯顏為徽政使，依前開府儀同三司、浚寧王、太保、錄軍國重事、知樞密院事。
units.en: Bayan was made Huizheng Court commissioner, continuing as before as Commissioner with the Ceremonial Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, Prince of Jünning, Grand Guardian, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and privy council administrator.
units.literal: Bayan was made Huizheng Court commissioner, continuing as before as Commissioner with the Ceremonial Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, Prince of Jünning, Grand Guardian, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and privy council administrator.

units.zh: 提調忠翊侍衛親軍都指揮使司事伯撒裏、右都威衛都指揮使常不蘭奚，並為徽政使。
units.en: Superintendent of the Loyal Support Palace Guard Personal Army Commander-in-Chief's Office Barsari and Right Capital Might Guard commander-in-chief Changbolanxi were both made Huizheng Court commissioners.
units.literal: Superintendent of the Loyal Support Palace Guard Personal Army Commander-in-Chief's Office Barsari and Right Capital Might Guard commander-in-chief Changbolanxi were both made Huizheng Court commissioners.

units.zh: 賜諸妃後大朝會賞賚有差。
units.en: The consorts and imperial concubines were granted graded rewards for the great court assembly.
units.literal: The consorts and imperial concubines were granted graded rewards for the great court assembly.

units.zh: 甲子，以諸王忽剌臺貧乏，賜鈔五百錠。
units.en: On jiazi day, because Prince Hulatai was impoverished, 500 ingots of notes were granted.
units.literal: On jiazi day, because Prince Hulatai was impoverished, five hundred ingots of notes were granted.

units.zh: 皇弟燕帖古思受戒於西僧加兒麻哇。
units.en: The Emperor's younger brother Yanq Tegus received precepts from the western monk Garmawa.
units.literal: The Emperor's younger brother Yanq Tegus received precepts from the western monk Garmawa.

units.zh: 敕：「百官及宿衛士有只孫衣者，凡與宴饗，皆服以侍。
units.en: An edict: "Among the hundred officials and palace guardsmen who possess zhisun garments, whenever they attend banquets and feasts they shall all wear them in attendance.
units.literal: An edict: "Among the hundred officials and palace guardsmen who possess zhisun garments, whenever they attend banquets and feasts they shall all wear them in attendance.

units.zh: 其或質諸人者，罪之。」
units.en: Those who pawn them to others are guilty of a crime."
units.literal: Those who pawn them to others are guilty of a crime."

units.zh: 丙寅，楚丘縣河堤壞，發民丁二千三百五十人修之。
units.en: On bingyin day, the river dike at Qiuchu County was breached; 2,350 corvée laborers were mobilized to repair it.
units.literal: On bingyin day, the river dike at Qiuchu County was breached; two thousand three hundred fifty corvée laborers were mobilized to repair it.

units.zh: 十一月己巳，詔翰林國史，集賢院、奎章閣學士院集議先皇帝廟號、神主、升祔武宗皇后及改元事。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the jisi day, an edict ordered the Hanlin National History Office, the Academy of Gathered Worthies, and the Kui Zhang Academy to assemble and deliberate on the late emperor's temple name, spirit tablet, elevation of Wuzong's empress to joint worship, and changing the era name.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jisi day, an edict ordered the Hanlin National History Office, the Academy of Gathered Worthies, and the Kui Zhang Academy to assemble and deliberate on the late emperor's temple name, spirit tablet, elevation of Empress Wuzong to joint worship, and changing the era name.

units.zh: 庚午，賜郯王徹徹禿以海寧州朐山、贛榆、沭陽三縣。
units.en: On the gengwu day, Prince of Tan Cheche Tu was granted Qushan, Ganyu, and Shuyang — the three counties of Haining Prefecture.
units.literal: On gengwu day, Prince of Tan Cheche Tu was granted Qushan, Ganyu, and Shuyang — three counties of Haining Prefecture.

units.zh: 壬申，命郯王徹徹禿鎮遼陽。
units.en: On the renshen day, Prince of Tan Cheche Tu was ordered to garrison Liaoyang.
units.literal: On renshen day, Prince of Tan Cheche Tu was ordered to garrison Liaoyang.

units.zh: 甲戌，遣宿衛官阿察赤以上皇太后玉冊告祭南郊，中書平章政事伯撒裏告祭太廟。
units.en: On the jiaxu day, palace guard officer Achachi was dispatched to announce sacrifice at the southern suburb with the jade register elevating the empress to grand empress dowager, and Central Secretariat associate grand councillor Barsari announced sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On jiaxu day, palace guard officer Achachi was dispatched to announce sacrifice at the southern suburb with the jade register elevating the empress to grand empress dowager, and Central Secretariat associate grand councillor Barsari announced sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 戊寅，奉玉冊、玉寶尊皇后曰皇太后。
units.en: On the wuyin day, the jade register and jade seal were presented to honor the empress as Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On wuyin day, the jade register and jade seal were presented to honor the empress as Grand Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 皇太后御興聖殿受朝賀。
units.en: The Grand Empress Dowager received court congratulations in the Hall of Sagacious Birth.
units.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager received court congratulations in the Hall of Sagacious Birth.

units.zh: 己卯，帝御大明殿受朝賀。
units.en: On the jimao day, the Emperor received court congratulations in Daming Hall.
units.literal: On jimao day, the Emperor received court congratulations in Daming Hall.

units.zh: 庚寅，賜諸王寬徹幣帛各二千匹，以周其貧。
units.en: On the gengyin day, Prince Kuanche was granted 2,000 bolts of silks and cloths each to relieve his poverty.
units.literal: On gengyin day, Prince Kuanche was granted two thousand bolts of silks and cloths each to relieve his poverty.

units.zh: 左欽察衛士饑，賑糧二月。
units.en: The Left Qipchaq Guard soldiers were suffering famine; grain relief was distributed for two months.
units.literal: The Left Qipchaq Guard soldiers were suffering famine; grain relief was distributed for two months.

units.zh: 壬辰，帝崩，年七歲。
units.en: On the renchen day, the Emperor died; he was seven years old.
units.literal: On renchen day, the Emperor died; he was seven years old.

units.zh: 甲午，葬起輦谷，從諸陵。
units.en: On the jiawu day, he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
units.literal: On jiawu day, he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

units.zh: 明年六月己巳，明宗長子妥歡帖木耳即位。
units.en: The following year, in the sixth month on the jisi day, Mingzong's eldest son Toghan Temür ascended the throne.
units.literal: The following year, sixth month, on jisi day, Mingzong's eldest son Toghan Temür ascended the throne.

units.zh: 至元四年三月辛酉，諡曰沖聖嗣孝，廟號寧宗。
units.en: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan, on the xinyou day of the third month, the posthumous title Chong Sheng Si Xiao was granted and the temple name Ningzong.
units.literal: Fourth year of Zhiyuan, third month, on xinyou day, the posthumous title Chong Sheng Si Xiao was granted and the temple name Ningzong.

units.zh: 四月乙酉，祔於太廟。
units.en: In the fourth month, on the yiyou day, he was joined in the Grand Temple.
units.literal: Fourth month, on yiyou day, he was joined in the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 遂改更庶政：命皇弟忽必烈領治蒙古、漢地民戶；
units.en: He then reorganized the government: his brother Kublai was put in charge of Mongol and Han households;
units.literal: He then reformed the government at large: he ordered his imperial brother Kublai to administer the Mongol and Han households;

units.zh: 秋七月，命忽必烈征大理，諸王禿兒花、撒立征身毒，怯的不花征沒裏奚，旭烈征西域素丹諸國。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Kublai was ordered against Dali; Princes Törel and Sali against Sind; Qutuq Buqa against the Merkit; and Hulagu against the sultanates of the west.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Kublai was ordered to campaign against Dali; the princes Törel and Sali against Sind; Qutuq Buqa against the Merkit; and Hulagu against the sultanates of the Western Regions.

units.zh: 八月，忽必烈次臨洮，命總帥汪田哥以城利州聞，欲為取蜀之計。
units.en: In the eighth month Kublai halted at Lintao and ordered the commander Wang Tiange to hold Lizhou as the first step toward taking Shu.
units.literal: In the eighth month Kublai halted at Lintao and ordered the commander Wang Tiange to hold Lizhou, intending this as the opening move for taking Shu.

units.zh: 九月，忽必烈次忒剌地，分兵三道以進。
units.en: In the ninth month Kublai halted at Tere and divided his force into three columns for the advance.
units.literal: In the ninth month Kublai halted at Tere and divided his army into three columns to advance.

units.zh: 忽必烈還自大理，留兀良合台攻諸夷之未附者，入覲於獵所。
units.en: Kublai returned from Dali, left Uriyangqadai to subdue the tribes still holding out, and came to the hunt to pay homage.
units.literal: Kublai returned from Dali, leaving Uriyangqadai to attack the unsubdued tribes and coming himself to the hunt to pay homage.

units.zh: 忽必烈遣沒兒合石詣行在所，奏請續簽內郡漢軍，從之。
units.en: Kublai dispatched Mör-gechi to the mobile court to ask for further conscription of Han troops from the interior circuits, and the petition was approved.
units.literal: Kublai sent Mör-gechi to the imperial camp to petition for conscripting more Han troops from the interior circuits; the request was granted.

units.zh: 忽必烈及諸王阿裏不哥、八里土、出木哈兒、玉龍塔失、昔烈吉、公主脫滅幹等來迎，大燕，既而各遣歸所部。
units.en: Kublai and the princes Ariq Böke, Bari-tu, Chumqar, Yulutas, and Siregi, together with Princess Tuomiegan, came out to meet him. A great feast was held, and afterward each was sent home to his domain.
units.literal: Kublai and the princes Ariq Böke, Bari-tu, Chumqar, Yulutas, Siregi, and Princess Tuomiegan came to meet him; a great banquet was held, and afterward each was sent back to his appanage.

units.zh: 命張柔從忽必烈征鄂，趨杭州。
units.en: Zhang Rou was ordered to march with Kublai against Ezhou and drive toward Hangzhou.
units.literal: Zhang Rou was ordered to follow Kublai in the campaign against Ezhou, pressing toward Hangzhou.

units.zh: 命忽必烈統諸路蒙古、漢軍伐宋。
units.en: Kublai was ordered to take command of the Mongol and Han armies of every circuit for the war against the Song.
units.literal: Kublai was ordered to command the Mongol and Han armies of all circuits in the campaign against the Song.

units.zh: 元年辛亥夏六月，西方諸王別兒哥、脫哈帖木兒，東方諸王也古、脫忽、亦孫哥、按只帶、塔察兒、別裏古帶，西方諸大將班裏赤等，東方諸大將也速不花等，復大會於闊帖兀阿闌之地，共推帝即皇帝位於斡難河。
units.en: In the first year (xinhai), in the sixth month of summer, the western princes Berke and Toghtamur, the eastern princes Yeke, Toghu, Yissüngge, Ajai, Tachar, and Belgütei, the western generals led by Barchin, and the eastern generals led by Yesu Buqa met again at Kötö'ü Adal and together enthroned him on the Onon River.
units.literal: In the first year, xinhai, summer, sixth month: the western princes Berke and Toghtamur; the eastern princes Yeke, Toghu, Yissüngge, Ajai, Tachar, and Belgütei; the western generals, including Barchin; and the eastern generals, including Yesu Buqa, met again at Kötö'ü Adal and together raised the Emperor to the throne on the Onon River.

units.zh: 二年壬子春正月，幸失灰之地，遣乞都不花攻末來吉兒都怯寨。
units.en: In the second year (renzi), in the first month of spring, he visited Shihui and sent Qutuq Buqa to attack the fortress of Mergen.
units.literal: In the second year, renzi, spring, first month, the Emperor visited Shihui; Qutuq Buqa was sent to attack the fortress of Mergen.

units.zh: 三年癸丑春正月，汪田哥修治利州，且屯田，蜀人莫敢侵軼。
units.en: In the third year (guichou), in the first month of spring, Wang Tiange repaired Lizhou and opened garrison farms; the people of Shu did not dare raid across the border.
units.literal: In the third year, guichou, spring, first month, Wang Tiange repaired Lizhou and opened fields for garrison farming; the people of Shu did not dare encroach.

units.zh: 四年甲寅春，帝獵于怯蹇叉罕。
units.en: In the fourth year (jiayin), in spring, the Emperor hunted at Qeqen Chaqan.
units.literal: In the fourth year, jiayin, spring, the Emperor hunted at Qeqen Chaqan.

units.zh: 冬，大獵于也滅干哈里叉海之地。
units.en: In winter a great hunt was held at Yemüqan Qariqai.
units.literal: In winter a great hunt was held at Yemüqan Qariqai.

units.zh: 六年丙辰春，大風起北方，砂礫飛揚，白日晦冥。
units.en: In the spring of the sixth year (bingchen) a gale blew out of the north, sand and gravel whirling until broad daylight went dim.
units.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, bingchen, a great wind rose from the north; sand and gravel flew about, and the bright day turned dark.

units.zh: 七年丁巳春，幸忽闌也兒吉。
units.en: In the spring of the seventh year (dingsi) he went to Hulan-yierji.
units.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, dingsi, he visited Hulan-yierji.

units.zh: 冬，帝度漠南，至於玉龍棧。
units.en: That winter the Emperor crossed south of the desert and reached Yulongzhan.
units.literal: In winter the Emperor crossed south of the desert as far as Yulongzhan.

units.zh: 八年戊午春正月朔，幸也裏本朵哈之地，受朝賀。
units.en: On New Year's Day in the spring of the eighth year (wuwu) he went to Yilibenduoha and received the court's congratulations.
units.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the eighth year, wuwu, he visited Yilibenduoha and received court congratulations.

units.zh: 二月，陳日煚傳國于長子光昺。
units.en: In the second month Trần Thái Tông abdicated in favor of his eldest son Quang Hựu.
units.literal: In the second month Trần Thái Tông passed the realm to his eldest son Quang Hựu.

units.zh: 十一月己酉，帝督軍先攻鵝頂堡。
units.en: On jiyou day in the eleventh month the Emperor took command in person and opened the assault on Eding Fort.
units.literal: On jiyou day in the eleventh month the Emperor personally directed the army, first attacking Eding Fort.

units.zh: 四月，我大元太祖法天啟運驛武皇帝來征。
units.en: In the fourth month our Great Yuan Founder, Genghis Khan, titled Align-with-Heaven, Opener-of-Fortune, and Expedited Martial, marched to attack.
units.literal: Fourth month: our Great Yuan Founder, the emperor titled Align-with-Heaven, Opener-of-Fortune, and Expedited Martial, came on campaign.

units.zh: 五月，遣使扈從皇后八不沙至自京師。
units.en: Fifth month, envoys were dispatched to escort Empress Babusha back from the capital.
units.literal: Fifth month, envoys were dispatched to escort Empress Babusha back from the capital.

units.zh: 武宗
units.en: Wuzong (Külüg)
units.literal: Wuzong.

units.zh: 卜魯罕皇后 （伯岳吾氏，勳臣普化之孫，駙馬脫里忽思之女。元貞初立為皇后，大德三年授冊寶。十一年帝崩，武宗立，廢后，徙東安州，尋賜死。成宗晚年多疾，后居中用事，而能信任相臣哈剌哈孫，以卒成大德之治，識者猶有取焉。） 失憐答里元妃 （弘吉列氏，早薨。至大元年追尊諡曰貞慈靜懿皇后，配享成廟。） 乞里吉忽帖尼皇后
units.en: Empress Buluhan (Baiyuewu, granddaughter of the meritorious minister Puhua and daughter of the imperial son-in-law Telihusi; made empress at the start of Yuanzhen and invested in 1299; when Temür died in 1307 Külüg deposed her, exiled her to Dong'an, and soon had her executed. Though she dominated the inner court during Temür's late illnesses, she trusted the chief minister Harqasun and helped bring the Dade reign to a stable close—a point critics still acknowledged). Primary Consort Shilian Dali (Kongirat; died young; posthumously titled Empress Zhenci Jingyi in 1308 and enshrined at Chengzong's temple). Empress Qilijihutieni.
units.literal: Empress Buluhan (Baiyuewu clan, granddaughter of meritorious minister Puhua, daughter of consort Telihusi; established as empress at the beginning of Yuanzhen; in the third year of Dade invested with seal and treasure; in the eleventh year the emperor died, Wuzong was established, the empress was deposed, moved to Dong'an Prefecture, and soon ordered to die by grant. In Chengzong's later years he had many illnesses; the empress held power within the palace yet was able to trust chief minister Harqasun, thereby completing the governance of Dade—those of discernment still found something to approve). Primary Consort Shilian Dali (Kongirat clan, early death; in the first year of Zhida posthumously honored with title Empress Zhenci Jingyi, enshrined with Chengzong's temple). Empress Qilijihutieni.

units.zh: 二年，帝弟圖帖睦爾以懷王出居於建康。
units.en: Second year, his younger brother Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang as Prince of Huai.
units.literal: Second year, his younger brother Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang as Prince of Huai.

units.zh: 九月壬申，懷王即位，是為文宗，改元天歷，詔天下曰：「謹俟大兄之至，以遂朕固讓之心。」
units.en: Ninth month, on renshen day, the Prince of Huai ascended the throne — this is Wenzong; the reign title was changed to Tianli, and an edict to the realm said, "We respectfully await our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill our firm intent to yield."
units.literal: Ninth month, on renshen day, the Prince of Huai ascended the throne — this is Wenzong; the reign title was changed to Tianli, and an edict to the realm said, "We respectfully await our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill our firm intent to yield."

units.zh: 於是帝方遠在沙漠，猝未能至，慮生他變，乃迎帝弟懷王於江陵，且宣言已遣使北迎帝，以安眾心。
units.en: At that time he was still far away in the desert and could not arrive suddenly; fearing other changes might arise, Yan Temür welcomed his younger brother the Prince of Huai at Jiangling and also proclaimed that envoys had already been dispatched north to welcome him, to reassure the multitude.
units.literal: At that time he was still far away in the desert and could not arrive suddenly; fearing other changes might arise, Yan Temür welcomed his younger brother the Prince of Huai at Jiangling and also proclaimed that envoys had already been dispatched north to welcome him, to reassure the multitude.

units.zh: 丁巳，懷王入京師，群臣請正大統，固讓曰：「大兄在北，以長以德，當有天下。
units.en: On dingsi day the Prince of Huai entered the capital; the hundred officials requested that the Great Foundation be rectified; he firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the north; by seniority and by virtue he should possess all under Heaven.
units.literal: On dingsi day the Prince of Huai entered the capital; the hundred officials requested that the Great Foundation be rectified; he firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the north; by seniority and by virtue he should possess all under Heaven.

units.zh: 是月己亥，皇太子復即皇帝位。
units.en: That month, on jihai day, the crown prince again assumed the imperial throne.
units.literal: That month, on jihai day, the crown prince again assumed the imperial throne.

units.zh: 遣武寧王徹徹禿及哈八兒禿立文宗為皇太子，仍立詹事院，罷儲慶司，以徹裏鐵木兒為中書平章政事，闊兒吉司為中書右丞，怯來、只兒哈郎並為甘肅行省平章政事，忽剌臺為江浙行省平章政事，那海為嶺北行省平章政事。
units.en: Prince Wuning Chechequ and Qabarqu were dispatched to install Wenzong as crown prince; the Crown Prince's Household was still established and the Office of Stored Blessings abolished; Cheli Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor, Kokejis central secretariat right vice chancellor, Qelai and Jirhalang were both made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillors, Hulatai was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor, and Nohai was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.
units.literal: Prince Wuning Chechequ and Qabarqu were dispatched to install Wenzong as crown prince; the Crown Prince's Household was still established and the Office of Stored Blessings abolished; Cheli Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor, Kokejis central secretariat right vice chancellor, Qelai and Jirhalang were both made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillors, Hulatai was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor, and Nohai was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.

units.zh: 必不得已，當明以朕志播告中外。」
units.en: If it cannot be avoided, my intent must be made clear and proclaimed within and without."
units.literal: If it cannot be avoided, my intent must be made clear and proclaimed within and without."

units.zh: 丙子，文宗受皇太子寶。
units.en: On bingzi day Wenzong received the crown prince's seal.
units.literal: On bingzi day Wenzong received the crown prince's seal.

units.zh: 天歷二年正月乙丑，文宗復遣中書左丞躍裏帖木兒來迎。
units.en: Second year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
units.literal: Second year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.

units.zh: 於是文宗遣哈散及撒迪等相繼來迎，朔漠諸王皆勸帝南還京師，遂發北邊。
units.en: Thereupon Wenzong dispatched Hasan and Sadi and others in succession to welcome him; the princes of the northern desert all urged him to return south to the capital, and he thereupon set out from the northern frontier.
units.literal: Thereupon Wenzong dispatched Hasan and Sadi and others in succession to welcome him; the princes of the northern desert all urged him to return south to the capital, and he thereupon set out from the northern frontier.

units.zh: 乙酉，撒迪等至，入見帝於行幄，以文宗命勸進。
units.en: On yiyou day Sadi and the others arrived and entered to see him at the traveling encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.
units.literal: On yiyou day Sadi and the others arrived and entered to see him at the traveling encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.

units.zh: 是月，文宗立奎章閣學士院於京師，遣人以除目來奏，帝並從之。
units.en: That month, Wenzong established the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academy at the capital and dispatched men to memorialize appointment orders; the Emperor approved them all.
units.literal: That month, Wenzong established the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academy at the capital and dispatched men to memorialize appointment orders; the Emperor approved them all.

units.zh: 辛酉，文宗遣右丞相燕鐵木兒奉皇帝寶來上，御史中丞八即剌、知樞密院事禿兒哈帖木兒等，各率其屬以從。
units.en: On xinyou day Wenzong dispatched right chancellor Yan Temür to present the imperial seal; surveillance vice censor Ba'irq, privy council administrator Tughqa Temür, and others each led their subordinates to follow.
units.literal: On xinyou day Wenzong dispatched right chancellor Yan Temür to present the imperial seal; surveillance vice censor Ba'irq, privy council administrator Tughqa Temür, and others each led their subordinates to follow.

units.zh: 辛丑，文宗立都督府於京師，遣使來奏，又以臺憲官除目來上，並從之。
units.en: On xinchou day Wenzong established a commandery-general's office at the capital and dispatched envoys to memorialize; censorate and surveillance appointment orders were also submitted — all were approved.
units.literal: On xinchou day Wenzong established a commandery-general's office at the capital and dispatched envoys to memorialize; censorate and surveillance appointment orders were also submitted — all were approved.

units.zh: 元史卷三十一：天厯二年正月乙丑，文宗復遣中書左丞伊爾特穆爾來迎。
units.en: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianli 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
units.literal: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianli 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.

units.zh: 乙酉，薩題等至，入見帝於行幄，以文宗命勸進。
units.en: On yiyou day Sadi and others arrived and had audience with the Emperor at the travel encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.
units.literal: On yiyou day Sadi and others arrived and had audience with the Emperor at the travel encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.

units.zh: 時倒剌沙在上都，立泰定皇帝子為皇帝，乃遣兵分道犯大都，而梁王王禪、右丞相答失鐵木兒、御史大夫紐澤、太尉不花等兵皆次於榆林，燕帖木兒與其弟撒敦、子唐其勢等，帥師與戰，屢敗之。
units.en: At that time Doresh was at Shangdu; he installed Emperor Taiding's son as emperor and dispatched troops in separate columns to attack Dadu; meanwhile Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, censor-in-chief Niudze, and grand marshal Buqa all encamped their armies at Yulin; Yan Temür with his younger brother Sadun, his son Tangqishi, and others commanded troops to give battle and repeatedly defeated them.
units.literal: At that time Doresh was at Shangdu; he installed Emperor Taiding's son as emperor and dispatched troops in separate columns to attack Dadu; meanwhile Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, censor-in-chief Niudze, and grand marshal Buqa all encamped their armies at Yulin; Yan Temür with his younger brother Sadun, his son Tangqishi, and others commanded troops to give battle and repeatedly defeated them.

units.zh: 三年三月癸酉，子懿璘質班生，是為寧宗。
units.en: Third year, third month, on guiyou day, his son Yilianzhen Shiraban was born — he who would become Emperor Ningzong.
units.literal: Third year, third month, on guiyou day, his son Yilianzhen Shiraban was born — he who would become Emperor Ningzong.

units.zh: 時僉樞密院事燕鐵木兒留守京師，遂謀舉義。
units.en: At that time associate privy council administrator Yan Temür remained to guard the capital and thereupon plotted to raise righteous action.
units.literal: At that time associate privy council administrator Yan Temür remained to guard the capital and thereupon plotted to raise righteous action.

units.zh: 庚午，命燕鐵木兒升用嶺北行省官吏，其餘官吏並賜散官一級。
units.en: On gengwu day Yan Timur was ordered to promote officials of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat; the remaining officials were all granted one grade of honorary rank.
units.literal: On gengwu day Yan Timur was ordered to promote officials of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat; the remaining officials were all granted one grade of honorary rank.

units.zh: 戊子，燕鐵木兒等奏：「中政院越中書擅奏除授，移文來征制敕，已如所請授之，然於大體非宜，乞申命禁止，庶使政權歸一。」
units.en: On wuzi day Yan Timur and others memorialized: "The Central Domestic Affairs Court, overstepping the central secretariat, has on its own authority memorialized appointments and removals, and sent documents demanding commission edicts; appointments have already been made as requested, yet this is not proper in the larger scheme of affairs; we request that orders be issued forbidding this, so that governmental authority may be unified."
units.literal: On wuzi day Yan Timur and others memorialized: "The Central Domestic Affairs Court, overstepping the central secretariat, has on its own authority memorialized appointments and removals, and sent documents demanding commission edicts; appointments have already been made as requested, yet this is not proper in the larger scheme of affairs; we request that orders be issued forbidding this, so that governmental authority may be unified."

units.zh: 四月癸巳，燕鐵木兒見帝於行在，率百官上皇帝寶，帝嘉其勛，拜太師，仍命為中書右丞相，開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事、監修國史、答剌罕、太平王並如故。
units.en: Fourth month, on guisi day Yan Temür saw the Emperor at the traveling palace and led the hundred officials in presenting the imperial seal; the Emperor praised his merit and made him grand preceptor, still appointing him central secretariat right chancellor, commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, supervisor of the state history, darughachi, and Prince of Taiping — all as before.
units.literal: Fourth month, on guisi day Yan Temür saw the Emperor at the traveling palace and led the hundred officials in presenting the imperial seal; the Emperor praised his merit and made him grand preceptor, still appointing him central secretariat right chancellor, commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, supervisor of the state history, darughachi, and Prince of Taiping — all as before.

units.zh: 八月甲午黎明，召百官集興聖宮，兵皆露刃，號於眾曰：「武皇有聖子二人，孝友仁文，天下歸心，大統所在，當迎立之，不從者死！」
units.en: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, he summoned the hundred officials to assemble at Xingsheng Palace; the troops all bared their blades and proclaimed to the multitude, "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons — filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; all under Heaven turn their hearts to them; the Great Foundation lies with them — we must welcome and install them; whoever does not obey shall die!"
units.literal: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, he summoned the hundred officials to assemble at Xingsheng Palace; the troops all bared their blades and proclaimed to the multitude, "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons — filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; all under Heaven turn their hearts to them; the Great Foundation lies with them — we must welcome and install them; whoever does not obey shall die!"

units.zh: 燕鐵木兒奏：「陛下君臨萬方，國家大事所系者，中書省、樞密院、御史臺而已，宜擇人居之。」
units.en: Yan Temür memorialized, "Your Majesty rules the myriad regions; what the state's great affairs depend upon is only the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, and the Censorate — suitable men should be chosen to fill them."
units.literal: Yan Temür memorialized, "Your Majesty rules the myriad regions; what the state's great affairs depend upon is only the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, and the Censorate — suitable men should be chosen to fill them."

units.zh: 燕鐵木兒與西安王阿剌忒納失裏固守內廷。
units.en: Yan Temür and Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri firmly held the inner court.
units.literal: Yan Temür and Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri firmly held the inner court.

units.zh: 復諭燕鐵木兒等曰：「凡京師百官，朕弟所用者，並仍其舊，卿等其以朕意諭之。」
units.en: He again instructed Yan Temür and the others, saying, "Of the hundred officials at the capital whom my younger brother employs, all shall remain as before; you should convey my intent to them."
units.literal: He again instructed Yan Temür and the others, saying, "Of the hundred officials at the capital whom my younger brother employs, all shall remain as before; you should convey my intent to them."

units.zh: 是日，帝宴諸王、大臣於行殿，燕鐵木兒、哈八兒禿、伯帖木兒、孛羅等侍。
units.en: That day the Emperor feasted the princes and great ministers in the traveling hall; Yan Temür, Qabarqu, Bo Temür, Boluo, and others attended.
units.literal: That day the Emperor feasted the princes and great ministers in the traveling hall; Yan Temür, Qabarqu, Bo Temür, Boluo, and others attended.

units.zh: 乙未，特命孛羅等傳旨，宣諭燕鐵木兒、伯答沙、火沙、哈八兒禿、八即剌等曰：「世祖皇帝立中書省、樞密院、御史臺及百司庶府，共治天下，大小職掌，已有定制。
units.en: On yimao day Boluo and others were specially charged to transmit the intent and proclaim to Yan Temür, Badashah, Huosha, Qabarqu, Ba'irq, and others, saying, "Shizu established the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, the Censorate, and the hundred offices and various bureaus to jointly govern all under Heaven; great and small duties already have fixed regulations.
units.literal: On yimao day Boluo and others were specially charged to transmit the intent and proclaim to Yan Temür, Badashah, Huosha, Qabarqu, Ba'irq, and others, saying, "Shizu established the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, the Censorate, and the hundred offices and various bureaus to jointly govern all under Heaven; great and small duties already have fixed regulations.

units.zh: 是歲夏四月丙寅，子妥歡帖木爾生，是為至正帝。
units.en: That year, summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, his son Toghan Temür was born — he who would become Emperor Zhizheng.
units.literal: That year, summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, his son Toghan Temür was born — he who would become Emperor Zhizheng.

units.zh: 明宗翼獻景孝皇帝，諱和世㻋，武宗長子也。
units.en: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.

units.zh: 十二月乙巳，知樞密院事臣也不倫等議請上尊謚曰翼獻景孝皇帝，廟號明宗。
units.en: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.

units.zh: 於是封帝為周王，出鎮雲南。
units.en: Thereupon he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and sent out to garrison Yunnan.
units.literal: Thereupon he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and sent out to garrison Yunnan.

units.zh: 復矯稱帝所遣使者自北方來，雲周王從諸王兵整駕南轅，旦夕即至矣。
units.en: He further falsely claimed that envoys dispatched by him had come from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling the princes' troops and turning the chariot south — he would arrive within the day.
units.literal: He further falsely claimed that envoys dispatched by him had come from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling the princes' troops and turning the chariot south — he would arrive within the day.

units.zh: 丙戌，帝即位於和寧之北，扈行諸王、大臣咸入賀，乃命撒迪遣人還報京師。
units.en: On bingxu day the Emperor ascended the throne north of Helin; the escorting princes and great ministers all entered to congratulate; he thereupon ordered Sadi to dispatch men back to report to the capital.
units.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor ascended the throne north of Helin; the escorting princes and great ministers all entered to congratulate; he thereupon ordered Sadi to dispatch men back to report to the capital.

units.zh: 庚寅，帝暴崩，年三十，葬起輦谷，從諸陵。
units.en: On gengyin day the Emperor died suddenly; he was 30 years old and was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
units.literal: On gengyin day the Emperor died suddenly; he was thirty years old and was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

units.zh: 成宗大德三年，命武宗撫軍北邊，帝以四年十一月壬子生。
units.en: In the third year of Dade under Chengzong, Wuzong was ordered to command troops on the northern frontier; he was born on renzi day in the eleventh month of the fourth year.
units.literal: In the third year of Dade under Chengzong, Wuzong was ordered to command troops on the northern frontier; he was born on renzi day in the eleventh month of the fourth year.

units.zh: 遣撒迪等還京師，帝命之曰：「朕弟曩嘗覽觀書史，邇者得無廢乎？
units.en: He dispatched Sadi and the others back to the capital; the Emperor charged them, saying, "My younger brother once perused books and histories — has he lately neglected them?
units.literal: He dispatched Sadi and the others back to the capital; the Emperor charged them, saying, "My younger brother once perused books and histories — has he lately neglected them?

units.zh: 聽政之暇，宜親賢士大夫，講論史籍，以知古今治亂得失。
units.en: In the leisure of hearing government, he should draw near worthy scholar-officials and discuss historical records, to know the gains and losses of governance through the ages.
units.literal: In the leisure of hearing government, he should draw near worthy scholar-officials and discuss historical records, to know the gains and losses of governance through the ages.

units.zh: 卿等至京師，當以朕意諭之。」
units.en: When you reach the capital, you should convey my intent to him."
units.literal: When you reach the capital, you should convey my intent to him."

units.zh: 丙寅，帝謂中書左丞躍裏帖木兒曰：「朕至上都，宗藩諸王必皆來會，非尋常朝會比也，諸王察阿臺今亦從朕遠來，有司供張，皆宜豫備。
units.en: On bingyin day the Emperor said to central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür, "When I reach Shangdu, the princes of the imperial domains will surely all come to assemble — this is not comparable to an ordinary court audience; Prince Cha'atai now also follows me from afar; the relevant offices' provisions for guests must all be prepared in advance.
units.literal: On bingyin day the Emperor said to central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür, "When I reach Shangdu, the princes of the imperial domains will surely all come to assemble — this is not comparable to an ordinary court audience; Prince Cha'atai now also follows me from afar; the relevant offices' provisions for guests must all be prepared in advance.

units.zh: 卿其與中書臣僚議之。」
units.en: You should deliberate on this with the secretariat ministers."
units.literal: You should deliberate on this with the secretariat ministers."

units.zh: 帝特命臺臣曰：「太祖皇帝嘗訓敕臣下云：『美色、名馬，人皆悅之，然方寸一有系累，即能壞名敗德。』
units.en: The Emperor specially charged the censorate officials, saying, "Taizu once admonished his ministers, saying, 'Beautiful women and famous horses — all men delight in them; yet if the heart's inch is once entangled, it can ruin name and virtue.'
units.literal: The Emperor specially charged the censorate officials, saying, "Taizu once admonished his ministers, saying, 'Beautiful women and famous horses — all men delight in them; yet if the heart's inch is once entangled, it can ruin name and virtue.'

units.zh: 卿等居風紀之司，亦嘗念及此乎？
units.en: You who hold the office of wind and discipline — have you also ever borne this in mind?
units.literal: You who hold the office of wind and discipline — have you also ever borne this in mind?

units.zh: 世祖初立御史臺，首命塔察兒、奔帖傑兒二人協司其政。
units.en: When Shizu first established the Censorate, he first appointed Taqachar and Bentejir to jointly administer its affairs.
units.literal: When Shizu first established the Censorate, he first appointed Taqachar and Bentejir to jointly administer its affairs.

units.zh: 天下國家，譬猶一人之身，中書則右手也，樞密則左手也。
units.en: All under Heaven and the state are like a single person's body — the Secretariat is the right hand, the Privy Council the left hand.
units.literal: All under Heaven and the state are like a single person's body — the Secretariat is the right hand, the Privy Council the left hand.

units.zh: 左右手有病，治之以良醫，省、院闕失，不以御史臺治之可乎？
units.en: When the left and right hands are ill, one treats them with a good physician — when the Secretariat and Privy Council have faults and omissions, can one fail to treat them through the Censorate?
units.literal: When the left and right hands are ill, one treats them with a good physician — when the Secretariat and Privy Council have faults and omissions, can one fail to treat them through the Censorate?

units.zh: 凡諸王、百司，違法越禮，一聽舉劾。
units.en: For all princes and the hundred offices, whoever violates law or oversteps ritual — all alike are to be impeached.
units.literal: For all princes and the hundred offices, whoever violates law or oversteps ritual — all alike are to be impeached.

units.zh: 風紀重則貪墨懼，猶斧斤重則入木深，其勢然也。
units.en: When wind and discipline are weighty, the greedy and corrupt will fear — as when the axe is heavy, it enters the wood deeply; such is the force of it.
units.literal: When wind and discipline are weighty, the greedy and corrupt will fear — as when the axe is heavy, it enters the wood deeply; such is the force of it.

units.zh: 朕有闕失，卿亦以聞，朕不爾責也。」
units.en: If I have faults and omissions, you too should report them — I shall not blame you for it."
units.literal: If I have faults and omissions, you too should report them — I shall not blame you for it."

units.zh: 帝諭闊兒吉思等曰：「修德應天，乃君臣當為之事，鐵木兒補化所言良是。
units.en: The Emperor instructed Kuorugusi and others: "Cultivating virtue to respond to Heaven is what ruler and ministers ought to do; what Temur Buqa said is indeed right.
units.literal: The Emperor instructed Kuorugusi and others: "Cultivating virtue to respond to Heaven is what ruler and ministers ought to do; what Temur Buqa said is indeed right.

units.zh: 天明可畏，朕未嘗斯須忘於懷也。
units.en: Heaven's clarity is to be feared; We have never for an instant forgotten this in Our heart.
units.literal: Heaven's clarity is to be feared; We have never for an instant forgotten this in Our heart.

units.zh: 皇太子來會，當與共圖其可以澤民利物者行之。
units.en: When the crown prince comes to meet Us, We should together plan what can benefit the people and bring them material good, and put it into practice.
units.literal: When the crown prince comes to meet Us, We should together plan what can benefit the people and bring them material good, and put it into practice.

units.zh: 卿等其以朕意諭群臣。」
units.en: You should convey Our meaning to the hundred officials."
units.literal: You should convey Our meaning to the hundred officials."

units.zh: 世祖命廷臣集律令章程，以為萬世法。
units.en: Shizu ordered court ministers to compile statutes and regulations as law for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: Shizu ordered court ministers to compile statutes and regulations as law for ten thousand generations.

units.zh: 成宗以來，列聖相承，罔不恪遵成憲。
units.en: From Chengzong onward, successive sage emperors have none failed to reverently observe the established constitution.
units.literal: From Chengzong onward, successive sage emperors have none failed to reverently observe the established constitution.

units.zh: 朕今居太祖、世祖所居之位，凡省、院、臺、百司庶政，詢謀僉同，摽譯所奏，以告於朕。
units.en: I now occupy the seat where Taizu and Shizu dwelt; for all Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and hundred-office affairs, after consultation and unanimous deliberation, translate what is memorialized and report it to me.
units.literal: I now occupy the seat where Taizu and Shizu dwelt; for all Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and hundred-office affairs, after consultation and unanimous deliberation, translate what is memorialized and report it to me.

units.zh: 軍務機密，樞密院當即以聞，毋以夙夜為間而稽留之。
units.en: Military affairs of secrecy — the Privy Council should report them immediately; do not delay on account of early or late hour.
units.literal: Military affairs of secrecy — the Privy Council should report them immediately; do not delay on account of early or late hour.

units.zh: 其他事務，果有所言，必先中書、院、臺，其下百司及纮禦之臣，毋得隔越陳請。
units.en: For other affairs, if there is truly something to say, one must first go through the Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate; subordinate hundred offices and ministers of the broad defense must not overstep ranks in submitting requests.
units.literal: For other affairs, if there is truly something to say, one must first go through the Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate; subordinate hundred offices and ministers of the broad defense must not overstep ranks in submitting requests.

units.zh: 宜宣諭諸司，咸俾聞知。
units.en: This should be proclaimed to the various offices, so that all may hear and know.
units.literal: This should be proclaimed to the various offices, so that all may hear and know.

units.zh: 儻違朕意，必罰無赦。」
units.en: If anyone violates my intent, punishment shall be without pardon."
units.literal: If anyone violates my intent, punishment shall be without pardon."

units.zh: 武宗崩，仁宗立，延祐三年春，議建東宮，時丞相鐵木叠而欲固位取寵，乃議立英宗為皇太子，又與太后幸臣識烈門譖帝於兩宮，浸潤久之，其計遂行。
units.en: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of Yanyou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.
units.literal: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of YanYou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.

units.zh: 歲戊辰七月庚午，泰定皇帝崩於上都，倒剌沙專權自用，逾月不立君，朝野疑懼。
units.en: Year wuchen, seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu; Doresh monopolized power and acted on his own authority; for more than a month no ruler was installed, and court and countryside were anxious and fearful.
units.literal: Year wuchen, seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu; Doresh monopolized power and acted on his own authority; for more than a month no ruler was installed, and court and countryside were anxious and fearful.

units.zh: 已而塔察兒、脫歡襲殺阿思罕、教化於河中，帝遂西行，至北邊金山。
units.en: Before long Taqachar and Tughon launched a surprise attack and killed Ashan and Jiaohua at Hezhong; he then went west and reached the Golden Mountain on the northern frontier.
units.literal: Before long Taqachar and Tughon launched a surprise attack and killed Ashan and Jiaohua at Hezhong; he then went west and reached the Golden Mountain on the northern frontier.

units.zh: 帝至其部，與定約束，每歲冬居紥顏，夏居斡羅斡察山，春則命從者耕於野泥，十餘年間，邊境寧謐。
units.en: When he reached their territory, he fixed regulations with them: each year they wintered at Jaya'an, summered at Olokoch'a Mountain, and in spring ordered their followers to farm at Yeni; for more than 10 years the frontier was tranquil.
units.literal: When he reached their territory, he fixed regulations with them: each year they wintered at Jaya'an, summered at Olokoch'a Mountain, and in spring ordered their followers to farm at Yeni; for more than ten years the frontier was tranquil.

units.zh: 乃命孛羅如京師，兩京之民聞帝使者至，歡呼鼓舞曰：「吾天子實自北來矣！」
units.en: He thereupon ordered Boluo to proceed to the capital; the people of the two capitals, hearing his envoys had arrived, shouted and danced for joy, saying, "Our Son of Heaven has truly come from the north!"
units.literal: He thereupon ordered Boluo to proceed to the capital; the people of the two capitals, hearing his envoys had arrived, shouted and danced for joy, saying, "Our Son of Heaven has truly come from the north!"
